nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why do some subjects decide not to buy bio-based clothes according to the survey?
nodes.answer: Some subjects decide not to buy bio-based clothes due to them being too expensive, with an average rating of 3.57.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Eco-conscious consumerism|Biodegradable household products_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: Why is the average willingness to pay for a t-shirt produced from recycled materials lower than for a bio-based one?
nodes.answer: The average willingness to pay for a t-shirt produced from recycled materials is lower because people perceive remanufactured products to be of lesser quality than new products, even though they are essentially new.
